subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live owner-session Telegram delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code shape looks targeted, but the changed behavior is visible Telegram/session delivery and the Mantis proof lane skipped, so automation should not decide proof sufficiency for maintainers.

options.title: Require Live Owner-Session Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing a background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Delivery Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, but then own the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes completion messages.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the related Telegram liveness/status contract settled before changing owner-session completion delivery.

recommendation.title: Require Live Owner-Session Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing a background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across heartbeat routing and subagent delivery boundaries where this proof decision lands.
